posts.text: Being one of the 82 stocks does not mean the company management was involved in manipulation. SEBI’s case was primarily against the people accumulating and promoting shares. The companies were the securities being traded. It was hard to manipulate the companies with bigger market cap so basically they chosen the smaller one. Was there any proof that management was involved? Amount involved was also very less.. it is below 100 Cr only as per my knowledge.. Social media theory is not new.. it is still going on.. It is up to you if you believe that or not..

posts.text: Karthik Iyer Parasuraman is DP’s brother, not son. Their relation and the cases against Karthik and Deccan Chronicle have all been declared in the RHPs of Afcom and FlysSBS. Edit: In one of the early concalls one participant asked about Flyington ( the aviation company founded by Deccan which then went under ). DP did not want to go into the topic, which is understandable, so it was not discussed.
